text: In recognition of the urgent need to expedite efforts to transform Toronto’s housing system, this report provides the CreateTO Board of Directors with a broad update of 2025 housing-related work items: Priority Housing Sites (7 sites) Housing Sites with Secured Proponents (2 sites) Housing Sites in Market (3 sites) Housing Sites that are Zoned and Tracking to Market calls/Securing a Proponent (7 sites) Housing Sites Tracking to Final Zoning (6 sites)
The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Received the report (July 7, 2025) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO for information.
